evidence.title: Dems face uphill battle in challenge to Georgia congressional map under new SCOTUS rules

occurrences.checkable_against: 11th Circuit opinion remanding the Georgia redistricting challenge
occurrences.quote_span: The appeals court instructed Jones to reconsider the challenge under the new framework established in Callais, which raised the bar for plaintiffs alleging racial discrimination in redistricting.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia election returns and voter-party preference or voting-pattern data by race
occurrences.quote_span: That distinction is especially important in Georgia, where Black voters overwhelmingly support Democratic candidates, creating significant overlap between race and partisan affiliation.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: 11th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals remand order in the Georgia redistricting litigation
occurrences.quote_span: The latest development came when the 11th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a lower court judgment striking down Georgia’s 2021 maps and returned the case to U.S. District Judge Steve Jones.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia enacted redistricting legislation and replacement district maps
occurrences.quote_span: Georgia subsequently enacted replacement maps that satisfied Jones’ order while preserving the Republican Party’s political advantage elsewhere.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: 11th Circuit remand order in the Georgia redistricting litigation
occurrences.quote_span: The 11th Circuit, however, did not automatically grant them a new trial or authorize them to rebuild their case from the beginning.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia congressional and state district maps in force before the November 2026 midterm elections
occurrences.quote_span: Whatever Jones decides is unlikely to alter Georgia’s districts before the November 2026 midterm elections .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court docket and orders in the remanded Georgia redistricting case
occurrences.quote_span: Jones must now decide how to handle the remanded case.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Joe Biden public remarks and statements about Georgia's 2021 election law
occurrences.quote_span: President Joe Biden put Georgia at the center of the national voting rights fight in 2021 when he branded the state’s Republican-backed election overhaul "Jim Crow in the 21st century."
occurrences.speaker: Joe Biden
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Federal court docket filings in the Georgia redistricting cases
occurrences.quote_span: Black voters and voting rights organizations filed three lawsuits challenging the maps between December 2021 and January 2022, arguing that the districts diluted Black voting power in violation of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court orders issued by Judge Steve Jones in the Georgia redistricting litigation
occurrences.quote_span: Jones ruled for the challengers in 2023 and ordered Georgia to create additional majority-Black districts , including one congressional district, two state Senate districts and five state House districts.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaintiffs' motions and filings in the remanded Georgia redistricting case
occurrences.quote_span: The plaintiffs could ask to supplement the record with revised maps, updated statistical analyses or additional evidence addressing the Supreme Court’s new requirements.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia's filings and Judge Steve Jones's orders in the remanded case
occurrences.quote_span: Georgia could argue that the plaintiffs have already received a full trial and that Jones should apply the new standard solely to the existing record.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia's briefs and legal filings in the remanded redistricting case
occurrences.quote_span: Georgia can argue that lawmakers were pursuing partisan objectives rather than targeting Black voters because of their race.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: Georgia election district maps and 2024 election administration records
occurrences.quote_span: Those maps were used in the 2024 elections and remain in place for the 2026 election cycle, while the legality of the original maps remained at the center of Georgia’s appeal.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps

occurrences.checkable_against: 11th Circuit disposition, Georgia election administration records, and 2023 replacement map legislation
occurrences.quote_span: The appeals court did not order the state to reinstate the original 2021 maps, and Georgia has already conducted its primaries using the replacement districts created from the 2023 map.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Georgia 2021 congressional and state redistricting maps
